The '''Corellian Merchants' Guild''' ('''CMG''') was a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning private trade organization that provided monetary aid, information, contacts and starship maintenance and repair [[Corellian Merchants' Guildhouse|facilities]] for its members. Only native [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] and the owners and crew of Corellian-made starships were eligible for membership.

==History==
Before the breakout of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] enacted ''[[Contemplanys Hermi]]'' resulting in Corellia's borders being sealed. With the borders sealed all interstellar trade vessels were ordered to drop their payloads in the [[Outlier systems]]. Afterwards the Corellian Merchants' Guild's transports would transfer the cargo to their proper destinations.

At this same time, all non-Corellian companies in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] were allowed to continue operating as long as they abided by the shipping and travel restrictions. This often required businesses to purchase a CMG membership.

During the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it was viewed as a hotbed of sedition and anti-Imperial activities by the Empire, but because the CMG was deeply entrenched in galactic commerce, the Empire could not easily pass a law to declare the organization illegal. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the Guild was banned from [[Corporate Sector/Legends|the Corporate Sector]].<ref name="AJ10">{{JournalCite|10|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
